listing.summary: This small mod adds 2 new ships, 7 variant ships from Vanilla: 1 Fighter, 1 Bomber, 1 Interceptor, and 9 weapons. Independents know the ships' blueprints, and the weapons and fighters are rare blueprints in the wild. This mod's ships and weapons are designed to be superior to vanilla.
listing.aiSummary: Adds new ships, variants, weapons, and fighters designed to be superior to vanilla.

description:
This small mod adds 2 new ships, 7 variant ships from Vanilla: 1 Fighter, 1 Bomber, 1 Interceptor, and 9 weapons. Independents know the ships' blueprints, and the weapons and fighters are rare blueprints in the wild. This mod's ships and weapons are designed to be superior to vanilla.

I hope everyone can enjoy this mod. Any problems, dm here.

Here are the ships:
The Silverfire:

This Variant of the Conquest was created to extract every drop of power from the design. The result is the most terrifying ship that ESV Corporation has ever produced. A missile boat capable of wiping out entire fleets on its own, effortlessly. If, of course, it is in the hands of a capable captain. It has 4 Large Missiles, 6 Medium Missiles, 6 Small Missiles and 6 Hybrid mounts. It has a Fast Missile Racks System.

The Cataphract:

A variant of the old Onslaught-class design that Elite Ships and Variants (ESV) Corporation engineers updated. The Cataphract is designed to be an aggressive front-line capital ship. It sacrifices shields for heavy armour. With the expertise of ESV Corporation, all systems were improved with special attention to the ship's engine. It has distributed fire control, heavy ballistic integration, 1 large missile, 1 large ballistic, 2 medium missiles, 7 medium ballistics, and 2 fighter bays. It has a plasma jet system.

The Hawk:

The Hawk is the latest ship from the Eagle and Falcon class lineage. The Hawk is a light cruiser that focuses on front-facing ballistics, equipped with ammo feeders. While fielding impressive firepower, the ship itself is quite fragile and relies on hit-and-run tactics and the range of its weapons to stay alive. It has A Dedicated target core, 4 medium ballistic, 5 composite and 2 small ballistic slots. It has an accelerated ammo feeder system.

The Heron EX:

The EX version of the Heron comes with more wings and a focus on missiles: 1 large missile, 2 medium and 2 small ballistic slots.

The Tarsus EX:

The EX version is a highly modified and militarized version of the Tarsus. Making it competitive even among other state-of-the-art carriers. It has ECCM, 1 medium missile slot, 2 small ballistic slots, and 2 wing slots with a reserve deployment system.

The Enforcer EX C:

The EX is the state-of-the-art version of the Enforcer. The C version is modified to accept a wing. It has a maneuvering jet system.

The Enforcer EX M:

The EX is the state-of-the-art version of the Enforcer. The M version is modified to accept a large Missile slot. It has a fast missile rack system.

The Enforcer EX G:

The EX is the state-of-the-art version of the Enforcer. The G version is modified to accept a large ballistic slot. It has an accelerated ammo feeder system.

The Wolf EX:

The EX version is a complete overhaul of the Wolf, making it a swift and versatile ship, but very fragile. It has a plasma jet system.

The Weapons:
-Ubirajara: Medium-range energy missile.
-Sabot Black Tip: A weaker sabot with longer range that regenerates the ammo.
-White Wall PD: Long-range, accurate kinetic PD.
-Harpoon Blue Tip: A small fragmentation missile with large damage for anti-ship.
-Dynamic Impactor Mark IV: Short-range, medium-high explosive cannon.
-Long Range Precision Cannon: As the name implies.
-Particle Hyper Velocity Cannon: Long-range kinetic cannon.
-Kinetic Storm: Short-range, small assault kinetic gun.
-Blue Scarab: Short-range, small assault high-explosive gun.
-Pegasus MRT: Energy unguided single-use torpedo.

The Fighters:

-Harpy: A fighter designed to hunt destroyers.
-Hellcry: A bomber designed to eliminate capital ships.
-Heaven Blaze: A drone interceptor designed to eliminate bombers and frigates.

Changelog:
1.8.5
-Visual correction of the engines of the Silverfire.
1.8.4
-Rewrote the description of the Silverfire.
-Raised the DP and supply cost of the Silverfire.
-Reduced the Flux Capacity of the Silverfire.
-Customized and rewrote the Hullmod enhanced missile package.
1.8.3
-Altered the large weapon arcs and CR deployment of the Silverfire.
-Updated the sprite of the Silverfire
-Added a unique built-in hullmod to the Silverfire.
- Colour-coded all Missiles from the mod by damage type.
1.8.0
-Added Silverfire Missile Battlecruiser.
-Added Pegasus MRT torpedo.
-Raised the ordnance points of the Heron EX.
-Rewrote a lot of descriptions.
1.7.5
-Added a COMBAT tag to the HINTS of Tarsus EX and HERON EX. May make them more aggressive; need feedback from you guys.
1.7.4
-Rebalance of the Cataphract, Heron EX, and Enforcer EX C ship autofit variant.
-Increased the spawn frequency chance of all ships by the Independent Faction.
1.7.3
-Rebalanced the Cataphract ship data.
1.7.2
-Increased the Cataphract, the Hawk and the Wolf EX shield boundary.
1.7.1
-Changed the Cataphract bound polygons.
1.7.0
-Added a new capital ship, the Cataphract. A heavily armoured battlecruiser.
1.6.3
-Increased the hit points of Hellcry's missiles.
1.6.2:
-Decreased the DPS of the Harpy and Heaven Blaze.
-Adjusted the hull and armour of the Harpy and Heaven Blaze.
1.6.1:
-Decreased the DPS of the Heaven Blaze.
1.6.0:
-Added a new drone interceptor, Heaven Blaze.
1.5.5:
-Updated the sprites of the Enforcer EX G and M, Tarsus EX and Heron EX.
1.5.4:
-New attempt to fix is not a valid ship variant ID in sim_opponents.
1.5.3:
-Increased the max ammo of the Ubirajara MRM.
-Adjusted the flux/shot of the Long Range Precision Cannon.
1.5.2:
-Attempting to fix is not a valid ship variant ID in sim_opponents.
- Re-adjusted the DPS and flux/shot of the Particle Hyper Velocity Cannon to previous levels.
1.5.1:
- Re-adjusted the DPS and flux/shot of the Particle Hyper Velocity Cannon.
-Adjusted impact values of various weapons.
1.5.0:
-Updated the Hawk and White Wall PD sprites.
-Added 5 new weapons:
-Dynamic Impactor Mark IV,
-Long Range Precision Cannon,
-Particle Hyper Velocity Cannon,
-Kinetic Storm,
-Blue Scarab.
1.4.2:
-Increased the shield arc on the Wolf EX.
1.4.1:
- Re-adjusted the CR recovery on the Wolf EX.
1.4.0:
-Increased the speed of the Hawk to 85.
-Added a new frigate, the Wolf EX. Fast and versatile.
1.3.2:
-Hopefully, fix the fighter weapons showing up with illegal arms dealers.
1.3.1:
-Fix the name description of the Hellcry.
1.3.0:
-Add a new bomber, the Hellcry.
1.2.1:
-Modify the refire delay and ammo regeneration time on the Harpoon blue tip.
1.2.0:
-Add a new small missile, the Harpoon blue tip.
1.1.1:
-Raise the range of Whitewall PD in the Harpy.
1.1.0:
-Add a new fighter, the Harpy.
1.0.1:
-A small change in the maneuverability of the Hawk.
